description.label: Description
description.value:
With the purest of pure hearts I shall burgeon my knowledge and spirit to face evil with the confidence, love and comfort of the Lady. To carry out her will, the banishment of tyranny is all. For I am her acolyte, now and forever.

Choose one Troth. Channelling, ingredients, and lore effects for @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-nom.nom-journals.JournalEntry.szhETavVooj84NXa.JournalEntryPage.n0mJrnlLoreGrail]{Lore of the Grail} use this Wind: Azyr (Lore of Heavens). Changing Troth is not offered.
